verdict.rationale: Baseten documents its own path for bringing open-source models onto the platform: a `config.yaml` naming a Hugging Face model, hardware, and engine is pushed with `truss push` / `baseten model push` to a dedicated endpoint. That lets an engineer self-deploy a new open-weight model without custom serving code, though only for supported architectures; otherwise a Python Model class is required. Nothing documents how quickly new releases are added to the hosted Model APIs catalog or whether new architectures get day-0 engine support. Missing for 10: evidence of day-0 or fast catalog additions to Model APIs, documented release-to-availability timelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of speed, and guaranteed support for new architectures.
